record.reason: TokenMixer-Large is an industrial recommendation ranking model with sparse-per-token experts, custom operators, FP8 and token-parallel serving. The engineering is inference-relevant but its architecture, workload and quality metrics are recommender-specific, so LLM transfer remains uncertain.
record.title: TokenMixer-Large: Scaling Up Large Ranking Models in Industrial Recommenders
